title: LLaVAShield: Safeguarding Multimodal Multi-Turn Dialogues in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using an automated red-teaming framework (MMRT) to generate unsafe multimodal multi-turn dialogues involving racial hate and slurs, and evaluating if the moderation model correctly flags them under the Hate & Harassment safety policy dimension.
